options.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one realistic production-quality desktop application UI visual design draft, at 1920 x 1080, natural 16:9. Input image 1 is the exact current FireWorksLab V5 editor; input image 2 is its component specification page. They are visual grounding, not images to paste into a collage. Current date 2026-10-29, no dates need to be shown.
Direction name: 精密参数台.
TASK: Visually refine the existing V5 component system without changing its main palette, overall layout, functionality, content roles or interaction logic. Render ONE full editor screen, no browser chrome, no surrounding presentation, no before/after montage, no option number. Retain same 48px top header, left effects library about 272px, large neutral-black fireworks preview in center, right inspector about 440px with structure tree above and parameter editor below, playback and tracks at bottom. Use the same gold dotted firework image composition from reference and existing thumbnail imagery. No extra feature, cards, metrics, panels, tabs, or decorative effects.
HARD INVARIANTS: blue-grey surfaces based on #111d21/#121f24/#1b2a2f, mint main accent EXACT #00d49b; selected fill #173d39; no purple/blue rebrand; small 2-4px corners and thin crisp borders, existing straight-edged tool aesthetic. Top tabs remain 实时模拟 / 引擎回放 / 贴图流转 / 交付清单. Top actions 保存 / 另存 / 导出素材包 stay where they are, visibly disabled in this demo. Left library selected object 金曜菊-B, ID GLB-S1, then 升空尾缀, 萤天凝霜焰, 金芒菊, 鸿巢四尺玉, 引菊→锦, 萤柠星. Right object 金曜菊-B / GLB-S1; tree retains root, layers, emitters, eye and observe target icons. Distinguish selected editing row with fine mint stroke and soft mint fill; eye visibility and target-only observation are separate.
VISUAL IDEA: a precise creative instrument. Establish confident typography hierarchy with local Chinese sans serif, page/object titles 18px/26 medium-semi-bold, section names 14px/22 semibold, field labels 13px/20, helper text 12px/18 subdued but readable. Numeric values in tabular monospaced 13px, never broken from their units. Parameter rows use consistent 40px rhythm, modules use 16-20px spacing instead of oversized empty gaps. Align all labels, slider rails, numeric inputs and compact reset/lock/help icon slots on vertical columns. Give numeric inputs 76-88px width and stable unit slots, without moving or hiding actions. Make current value visually stronger than unit, helper or metadata. Same fields 节奏, 层长, 线条宽度, values 1 ×, preset buttons ×0.8 / 原样 / ×1.25 / ×1.5 / ×2. Keep summary 3.57 s · 75 帧 · 5 张 clearly grouped as value+unit atoms, not new cards. Existing module list 整体调整 / 形状 / 运动与亮度 / 关联图层 / 输出与资源 stays intact. Distinguish module headings with slightly lighter same-family surface and restrained typography, not extra enclosures. Use one consistent outline icon family. No glow, gradients, shadows on ordinary controls, giant text, pill controls or large rounded cards.
STATE QUALITY: actionable buttons have visible neutral surface and readable thin outline; disabled actions keep readable muted text with reduced surface/border rather than disappearing; readonly is identifiable from non-editable surface and no caret, not same as disabled. Focus rings crisp 2px mint, hover neutral lighter border, selected soft mint fill plus border; changed uses restrained amber #e4bb7c, errors coral #e7735a only where appropriate. Do not add errors to this screen. All Chinese text sharp and correctly rendered. Existing '设计示意 · 未计算 · 未连接资源' labels must stay concise and clearly legible, never fabricate saved/exported/imported success. Preserve all existing UI regions and operations, only improve visual hierarchy, spacing, density, readability and consistency.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create one realistic, production-quality desktop FireWorksLab V5 UI visual draft at 1920 x 1080 natural 16:9. Input image 1 is the current actual editor screenshot; image 2 is its component specification reference. Render ONE full editor screen. Do not render a comparison, presentation slide, multiple ideas, title board, browser chrome, or option number. Current date 2026-10-29; no visible dates necessary.
Direction name: 安静工作区.
Brief: refine the existing components through stronger hierarchy, restrained typography, careful density and coherent states. Keep current brand/main palette #00d49b mint with blue-grey #111d21 / #121f24 / #1b2a2f / #24373d. May adjust tonal contrast and auxiliary colours. Preserve straight-edged professional tool style, thin borders, 2-4px control radius. Absolutely no visual rebrand, glow, gradients, big round cards, new decorative elements.
Lock reference layout and behavior: 48px top header, about272px left effect library, same large neutral-black central golden dotted firework preview, about440px right inspector with structure tree above parameters, same playback/three layer tracks at bottom. No operation removed or relocated between regions. Retain top tabs 实时模拟 / 引擎回放 / 贴图流转 / 交付清单 and disabled 保存 / 另存 / 导出素材包. Left selected 金曜菊-B GLB-S1 · 三层, then existing other effects and real matching thumbnail images. Right selected tree layer 引菊→锦 · 金锦层, same parent/child depth, eye and observation target controls. Observer menu and visibility are separate; keep the design-demo/未计算/未连接资源 labels, no fictional success status.
DISTINCT VISUAL STRATEGY: quiet surfaces and fewer competing outlines. The picture and current editing target are the focal points. Use FLAT SOLID surfaces ONLY; the inspector has subtle blue-grey raised fill against the darker library. Inactive tabs form one continuous low-contrast segmented rail, active tab uses mint text plus a fine bottom indicator INSIDE original tab bounds rather than drawing many brightly outlined boxes. Selected library row uses soft mint fill and a single thin mint edge. Neutral buttons keep readable borders only at actual clickable control boundaries, never border whole unrelated text blocks. Tree nodes align to a quiet indentation guide and clear hierarchy; selected layer has soft mint band and precise 1px mint outline. Main titles 17-18 semibold, section titles14 semibold, labels13 regular, metadata12 subdued but clearly readable. Avoid every title being bold white. Retain local Chinese sans and monospaced tabular numbers.
PARAMETER TREATMENT: preserve fields 节奏 / 层长 / 线条宽度 and all slider, numeric, unit, reset, lock, help operations. The main scanned pair is label and right-aligned 1 × value; group slider and exact input consistently, leaving 8px between numeric unit and three compact icons. Numeric entry about76px, same column. Use a calm shared baseline with 40px row pitch, 8px in-row gaps, 16px module separation, about12px module header inner padding. Overall summary '3.57 s · 75 帧 · 5 张' is emphasized by tabular numerals; the line '示意摘要，非当前参数计算结果' sits one hierarchy lower. Preset actions ×0.8 / 原样 / ×1.25 / ×1.5 / ×2 look like a consistent quiet segmented group, not primary CTAs. Existing fold headers 形状 / 运动与亮度 / 关联图层 / 输出与资源 have compact predictable heights and restrained separators, no 70px empty blocks. Do not show additional expanded modules or invent content.
STATES: visible hover via neutral edge/surface change, focus via 2px mint outline, selected via soft mint fill plus spatial cue, modified via amber marker AND text, errors coral with text (no new error on editor). Disabled text remains readable at reduced emphasis, rather than using full opacity fade. Readonly uses stable non-editable styling distinct from disabled. Icon style uniform simple outlines. Black preview remains neutral and its existing gold firework composition unchanged in shape, not redesigned. Aim for a quiet, intentional tool interface, not a marketing dashboard. Chinese text exact and sharp.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE realistic, high-fidelity desktop FireWorksLab V5 editor design draft at 1920 x 1080, natural16:9. Image 1 is the current actual editor UI and image2 the existing component specification. Use as visual grounding. One full application screen only, no browser, title board, collage, comparison, option numbers or feature inventory. Current date 2026-10-29 no dates necessary.
Direction name: 清晰阅读.
USER CONSTRAINTS: preserve main blue-grey/mint palette, entire overall three-column layout, all functionality and interaction semantics. Only refine component appearance, hierarchy, typography, spacing, density and state clarity. Main accent EXACT #00d49b, selection #173d39, canvas neutral nearly black. Keep sharp practical tool aesthetic, 1px borders, 2-4px corners. No rounded cards, gradients, glow, decorative illustration or rebranding. Same top48px header, left272px effects library, central original gold dotted firework image preview on neutral black, right440px inspector with structure above parameters and existing horizontal splitter, bottom same playback and three tracks. Use real reference gold firework composition and matching source thumbnail pictures, not new assets.
DISTINCT IDEA: a more readable inspector with genuinely clearer local information hierarchy. Make the right inspector a visibly lighter FLAT blue-grey #20343b / #243a42, separated from dark #111d21 library and #0b0f15 preview; headers stay #17292f. Increase current object title to19px/26 semibold, section headings15px/22 semibold, labels14px/22, secondary information12px/18. Use local clean Chinese UI sans serif and tabular monospaced numeric values. Primary text #e4edef and helper #b4c5cb, no white glare.
PARAMETER COMPONENT VARIANT (important): keep same three parameters 节奏 / 层长 / 线条宽度 and all their original operations, but give EACH parameter a carefully designed TWO-LINE row: label on upper left, precise numeric input '1' + inseparable '×' unit on upper right; underneath a long, clean mint slider rail on left and compact reset, lock, help icon operations on right. Align all three numeric inputs vertically. Approximately58px per two-line row, 8px internal gap, no enclosing card or box around each parameter; only a fine divider between rows. This changes component composition for readability without changing functions or overall layout. All existing operations remain visible and sufficiently spaced, use simple consistent outline icons. Numeric entry width80px. Exact current values stand out, slider thumb clear and restrained. The same module 整体调整 is expanded, with '75 帧 · 5 张 · 示意' quiet right-aligned in module header. Summary '3.57 s · 75 帧 · 5 张' follows three fields, numeric values brighter and units secondary, then helper '示意摘要，非当前参数计算结果' and presets ×0.8 / 原样 / ×1.25 / ×1.5 / ×2. Existing folded sections 形状 / 运动与亮度 / 关联图层 / 输出与资源 are compact36-40px high with clear text and one thin separator, no oversized blank spacing. No extra expanded section or new content.
Rest of editor is IDENTICAL in hierarchy and control location: top tabs 实时模拟 / 引擎回放 / 贴图流转 / 交付清单, top disabled actions 保存 / 另存 / 导出素材包, left selected 金曜菊-B GLB-S1 · 三层 then existing effects 升空尾缀, 萤天凝霜焰, 金芒菊, 鸿巢四尺玉, 引菊→锦, 萤柠星 etc. Reference tree selected 引菊→锦 · 金锦层, same root/children/depth and eye/target columns, mint selected band plus border, subdued node type labels. Object title 金曜菊-B / GLB-S1. Search, 仅改动, 英文名 remain in current region. Keep 静态参考 / 设计示意 · 未计算 · 未连接资源 legible. Do not fabricate export, save or UE success.
STATE LANGUAGE: contrast made readable independently of color; selected soft mint fill and outline, focus2px mint ring with offset, hover neutral boundary, disabled button readable muted text with low-contrast surface and no excessive full-element opacity, readonly stable value styling without edit affordance, modified amber and errors coral only when appropriate (no new error here). Left thumbnails keep original44px and names have clear primary/secondary role. Center remains the large visual anchor. Chinese text crisp, proper letters and symbols, no fake tiny text. Render the whole full-height screen uncropped, all key footer controls visible.
